_comment: Cisco Networking Academy style, reverse-engineered directly from AIW_Prompt_L02_clean_workflow.pptx (Eddy's 'Prompt like an engineer' course deck) -- not placeholders. Colors come from that deck's ppt/theme/theme1.xml <a:clrScheme> (Custom 1) and were cross-checked against actual fill-color usage counts across its 30 slides. Fonts come from that same theme's <a:fontScheme> ('CiscoSansTT ExtraLight' / 'CiscoSansTT Light') -- these are licensed Cisco fonts and will NOT be installed on a machine outside Cisco's network; LibreOffice/PowerPoint will silently substitute a fallback (Arial/Calibri) if missing, which is fine for drafting but check before a real recording.
_comment_titles: Source deck's content-slide titles are plain text, top-left, NOT a filled banner -- confirmed visually across multiple slides. 'title_banner' (filled navy, centered, white text) is kept separately for a section-divider/title-card use, matching the source deck's actual title slide.
_comment_card: The recurring left-side 'recap card' seen on nearly every content slide in the source deck: a cyan-bordered rounded rectangle, a short bold cyan header, and 1-3 lines of black body text, with an optional black icon near the bottom. Because a rectangle can only hold ONE text run, build a card as 3 stacked elements: one 'card' (the box, no text), one 'card_title' text on top, one 'card_body' text below it -- see jobs/code_with_ai_c1_lesson0/ for a worked example.
_comment_badges: The source deck's other recurring pattern: a small icon centered on a solid-color circle ('badge'), often clustered in groups of 2-5, one accent color per badge. Build one as 2 stacked elements: an 'oval' with the matching badge_* style (no text), then an 'image' (icon=...) centered on top, sized ~55-65% of the circle's diameter. Pick the badge color for what the icon represents, not decoratively -- the source deck is consistent about this (e.g. red badges only ever mean stop/error, green only success).
